series_title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
synthesis_notes: Across all candidates, narrative continuity and emotional causality were prioritized by pairing intense setup beats with direct thematic or explicit payoffs. Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_01 connects Catherine's unpunished physical brutality against Juliana in Episode 25 to her complete humiliation in Episode 44, where the Duke turns his back on her in front of high society. Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_02 uses dialogue rhyming, bookending Juliana's whispered reliance on 'Alexander' when beaten by thugs in Episode 15 with her steadfast faith as she faces death in Episode 38. Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_03 contrasts military breach action with ecclesiastical nullification. Candidate SYNTH_MULTI_04 uses a visual match cut on the scorched botanical grimoire between dungeon torture and courtroom trial. All duration centiseconds strictly adhere to element boundary calculations.

transition_instructions: Cut sharply from Juliana naming 'Lady Catherine' in Episode 25 to Catherine screaming 'I was supposed to be your Duchess!' in Episode 44, using a dramatic audio bass drop on the cut to establish immediate thematic cause-and-effect retribution.
